name: monte-carlo
description: Enterprise Monte Carlo portfolio simulation and stress testing platform

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/.next')) fs.cpSync('frontend/.next', '.next', {recursive:true,force:true}); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/public')) fs.cpSync('frontend/public', 'public', {recursive:true,force:true});"
